title: FuelChunkLoader
description: FuelChunkLoader is a lightweight and stable chunkloader plugin for Paper servers
body:
Fuel-based chunkloader with levels for Paper servers

FuelChunkLoader is a lightweight and stable chunkloader plugin for Paper servers. It keeps chunks fully simulated using real simulation tickets, allowing farms, redstone, crops, furnaces, and mob spawning to continue working even when no players are nearby.

The plugin uses a fuel system based on vanilla furnace mechanics and introduces progression through multiple chunkloader levels.

Main Features

Real simulation tickets (full chunk activity)

Fuel system based on vanilla furnace values

Three chunkloader tiers with different areas and fuel usage

One chunkloader per player (server-friendly design)

Persistent across server restarts

Visual particle preview of the loaded area

Optimized fuel calculations (low CPU usage)

Simple and intuitive in-game interaction

Chunkloader Levels Level Block Area Fuel Usage Iron Iron Block 1×1 chunk Normal Gold Gold Block 3×3 chunks 2× consumption Diamond Diamond Block 5×5 chunks 4× consumption Fuel System

The plugin uses the same fuel logic as the vanilla furnace. Stronger chunkloaders consume fuel faster depending on their level.

Fuel Iron => Stick= 30s/Wood=1m 30s/Coal+Charcoal=8 min/Blaze Rod=12 min/Coal Block=1h 20min/Lava Bucket=1h 40min

Gold => Stick=15s/Wood=4 min/Coal+Charcoal=4 min/Blaze Rod=6 min/Coal Block=40 min/Lava Bucket=50 min

Diamond => Stick=7s/Wood=22s/Coal+Charcoal=2 min/Blaze Rod=3 min/Coal Block=20 min/Lava Bucket=25 min

Place a block:

Iron block → 1×1 chunkloader

Gold block → 3×3 chunkloader

Diamond block → 5×5 chunkloader

Right-click the block with a feather to activate it.

Right-click the block with furnace fuel to add fuel.

Right-click with an empty hand to check remaining time.

Break the block to remove the chunkloader.

Each player can have only one active chunkloader at a time.

Requirements

Paper 1.21+

No external dependencies

Language Notice

The plugin’s in-game messages are currently only in English(default) and Portuguese(ativa automatico ao jogar o jogo em portugues).
